subject: Case study rights & timing — concession trade (request for exec exception)
messages:
From: Sienna Torres <sienna.torres@cloudbright.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: paul.pfister@cloudbright.com
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: case study & brand usage tied to renewal concession

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the competitive numbers on the renewal. We reviewed internally and can move to a longer-term commitment, but one of our conditions is a public case study and joint press mention during our product launch in Q1.

High-level ask from our side: in exchange for a 35% one-time renewal credit and a short co-marketing push (social + 1 webinar), CloudBright would like:
- A 1-page case study + quote attributed to our CPO (we'll provide suggested text)
- Logo usage on Redwood marketing pages and the press release
- First-look review of the case study copy 3 business days prior to publication

Attached our brand guidelines and a draft of the case study copy (CloudBright_case_study_draft.docx).

We appreciate there may be legal or policy constraints — if there's a standard exchange (e.g., lower credit + longer publicity rights) we're open to alternatives. We need to confirm timing by Nov 15 to align with our PR calendar.

Best,
Sienna
Sienna Torres
Head of Partnerships, CloudBright
Sienna.Torres@cloudbright.com
(415) 555-0198

Attachments: CloudBright_brand_guidelines.pdf, CloudBright_case_study_draft.docx

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 09:48:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: case study & brand usage tied to renewal concession

Folks — forwarding CloudBright's ask. Quick summary: they want a 35% renewal credit in exchange for a public case study + logo/quote use and a PR mention on their launch timeline (need confirm by Nov 15). They attached brand guidelines and a case-study draft.

Questions for approvals/team:
- Legal: any red flags with the requested quote attribution and logo usage? Standard review window (3 business days) is ok?
- Sales/Rev: we currently have authority up to 25% credit; approving 35% requires exec OK.
- Marketing: is the ask (logo + press mention + 1 webinar) acceptable scope for a 10% additional concession? Would rather negotiate additional distribution commitments (e.g., webinar co-sponsorship + top-of-funnel mention).

I recommend we take a conditional approach: agree in principle if CloudBright signs our publicity release (with limited exclusivity language) and confirms the quote text 3 days ahead. If execs approve, I'll send a DocuSign with the publicity addendum and the revised credit numbers.

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com

Attachment (from customer): CloudBright_case_study_draft.docx

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 10:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: case study & brand usage tied to renewal concession

Ben —

Quick legal read: the core items are okay but we need to tighten the publicity language. Redlines / concerns:
1) No indefinite exclusive rights — we can grant logo and quote use for 12 months from publication date, not exclusive.
2) Standard review window 3 business days is fine, but we need the final right to request minor edits for accuracy / compliance.
3) No contractual obligation to push a Redwood-originated press release; co-marketing commitments should be limited to jointly agreed assets (one webinar, three social posts).
4) Need an indemnity carve-out that covers misstatements in the customer-provided quote.

If sales wants to hit 35% total concession, legal requires the publicity addendum signed and that the credit be structured as a time-limited promotional credit (applied over first renewal invoice) — that avoids permanent list-price changes.

I'll prepare a one-page publicity addendum and a brief set of redlines. Please confirm we have exec ok to move from 25% to 35% if legal conditions are accepted.

— Laura
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 12:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: case study & brand usage tied to renewal concession

Ben — thanks for flagging. High-level stance from exec: we can approve the extra 10% (to get to 35%) on the following non-negotiable conditions:
1) Publicity addendum signed and executed via DocuSign before the credit is applied.
2) Logo/quote usage limited to 12 months; Redwood retains final sign-off on quote wording.
3) Credits must be applied as a promotional, one-time credit (not a permanent price change).
4) Marketing must confirm we get webinar co-sponsorship and a minimum of three social amplifications with Redwood tag + one logo placement on CloudBright PR materials.

If all four are met, I approve the exception. Ben, please get the addendum drafted with Laura and route for DocuSign. Karthik, please confirm whether the revenue team is comfortable booking with the promotional credit structure.

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP Revenue | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sienna Torres <sienna.torres@cloudbright.com>
Cc: paul.pfister@cloudbright.com
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 16:42:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Request: case study & brand usage tied to renewal concession

Hi Sienna — great to hear the timeline. Thanks for the materials; we appreciate the draft.

Good news: We've got conditional executive approval for the full 35% renewal credit in exchange for the case study and co-marketing package. Conditions to sign-off (per legal/exec):
- Sign our one-page publicity addendum (DocuSign link below) that limits logo/quote usage to 12 months and preserves Redwood final sign-off of the quote wording.
- The credit will be issued as a one-time promotional credit applied to the first renewal invoice (not a permanent price change).
- We require the copy review window of 3 business days and an indemnity carve-out for customer-provided quotes.
- Marketing commitments: 1 joint webinar + 3 social posts + logo on CloudBright's launch page.

If you agree, we will send the DocuSign publicity addendum (attached: DocuSign_CaseStudy_CloudBright.pdf) and route for signature. Upon execution we will apply the credit and coordinate dates for the co-marketing items. Please confirm by EOD Tue Nov 10 to keep your Nov 15 PR milestone.

Thanks and looking forward —
Ben
